title: Consistent and grounded / Playful and expressive
slide_intent: Distinguish stable identifiers from flexible expression because recognition and variety require different kinds of control.
strategic_value: Stable logo, palette and type can let Mailchimp vary illustration and photography without losing its identity.
demonstration: Two alternating text-and-image groups contrast regular geometric faces with irregular faces; the copy distinguishes structural and flexible brand elements.
practical_value: Decide which elements provide continuity and which can carry variation.

reference_purposes.Intent: The visible text explains that structural elements support recognition while flexible media broaden expression.
reference_purposes.Application: The page assigns logo, palette and typography a different role from illustration, animation and photography.

ingredient.name: Stable and flexible elements
ingredient.role: Maintain recognition while allowing emotional range.
ingredient.application: Use the source’s distinction between structural identifiers and flexible image media when planning variation.
